info.name: Get details for the specified revision.

params.name: cid
params.description: The company or enterprise ID that owns the resource.

params.name: pnum
params.description: Part number.

params.name: revision
params.description: ID of the revision to get

params.name: elementType
params.description: Element Type. Must be one of: `-1`: Unknown, `0`: Part Studio, `1`: Assembly, `2`: Drawing. `4` : Blob, `8`: Variable Studio

items.docs: If the `revision` parameter is left blank, the latest revision information is returned. See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-latest-revision-info) for more details.

info.name: Get all revisions for a company.

params.name: cid
params.description: The company or enterprise ID that owns the resource.

params.name: elementType
params.description: Element Type. Must be one of: `-1`: Unknown, `0`: Part Studio, `1`: Assembly, `2`: Drawing. `4` : Blob, `8`: Variable Studio

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of list entries to return in a single API call.

params.name: latestOnly
params.description: Whether to limit search to only latest revisions.

params.name: after
params.description: The earliest creation date of the revision to find.

items.docs:
See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-all-revisions) for more details. 
* Returns a list of `limit` size of all objects per API call. 
* To get the next set of results, use the `next` URL from the response body. 
* Do not change any other query parameters during subsequent enumeration. 
* Persist `after` query param value and use it to begin a fresh enumeration at a later date. 
* This API can only be called by company admins.

info.name: Get all revisions for an element (tab).

params.name: cid
params.description: The company or enterprise ID that owns the resource.

params.name: did
params.description: The id of the document in which to perform the operation.

params.name: linkDocumentId
params.description: The id of the document through which the above document should be accessed; only applicable when accessing a version of the document. This allows a user who has access to document a to see data from document b, as long as document b has been linked to document a by a user who has permission to both.

params.name: wv
params.description: Indicates which of workspace (w) or version (v) id is specified below.

params.name: wvid
params.description: The id of the workspace, version in which the operation should be performed.

params.name: eid
params.description: The id of the element in which to perform the operation.

params.name: configuration
params.description: URL-encoded string of configuration values (separated by `;`). See the [Configurations API Guide](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/configs/) for details.

params.name: elementType
params.description: Element Type. Must be one of: `-1`: Unknown, `0`: Part Studio, `1`: Assembly, `2`: Drawing. `4` : Blob, `8`: Variable Studio

params.name: fillApprovers
params.description: Set to `true` to return a list of approvers. Default is `false` and will return `null`.

params.name: fillExportPermission
params.description: Set to `true` to return a list of export permissions. Default is `false` and will return `null`.

params.name: supportChangeType
params.description: Whether the revision can change object type. Used in reuse part number flow.

items.docs: See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-latest-revision-info) for more details.

info.name: Get all revisions for a part number.

params.name: cid
params.description: The company or enterprise ID that owns the resource.

params.name: pnum
params.description: Part number.

params.name: elementType
params.description: Element Type. Must be one of: `-1`: Unknown, `0`: Part Studio, `1`: Assembly, `2`: Drawing. `4` : Blob, `8`: Variable Studio

params.name: fillApprovers
params.description: Set to `true` to return a list of approvers. Default is `false` and will return `null`.

params.name: fillExportPermission
params.description: Set to `true` to return a list of export permissions. Default is `false` and will return `null`.

params.name: supportChangeType
params.description: Whether the revision can change object type. Used in reuse part number flow.

items.docs: You can also request `elementType` in addition to `partNumber` since companies may or may not allow drawings to share part numbers with their parts/assemblies. To perform search without `elementType`, use `elementType = -1` (UNKNOWN).  See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-all-revisions) for more details.

info.name: Delete all revisions for a part number.

params.name: cid
params.description: The company or enterprise ID that owns the resource.

params.name: pnum
params.description: Part number.

params.name: et
params.description: Element Type. Must be one of: `0`: Part Studio, `1`: Assembly, `2`: Drawing. `4` : Blob

params.name: ignoreLinkedDocuments
params.description: By default, revisions will be deleted for the part number in the specified, and all linked documents. Set to `true` to only delete revisions in the specified document.

items.docs: Only company admins can call this API. All documents that contain or use the part number must be deleted first. This operation cannot be undone.

info.name: Get all revisions for a document.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all revisions that exist in a document and are owned by the document's owning company.  See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-all-revisions) for more details.

info.name: Get all revisions for a version.

params.name: did
params.description: Document ID.

params.name: vid
params.description: Version ID.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all revisions that exist in a document version and are owned by the document's owning company.  See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-all-revisions) for more details.

params.name: pnum

params.name: et
params.description: Element Type. Must be one of: `-1`: Unknown, `0`: Part Studio, `1`: Assembly, `2`: Drawing. `4` : Blob, `8`: Variable Studio

items.docs: See [API Guide: Release Management](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/relmgmt/#get-latest-revision-info) for more details. Returns 204 if no revisions are found.
